text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly focuses on national-scale (China mainland) spatial optimization of urban land and cropland using the LANDSCAPE cellular automata model to simulate future land use in 2030. It implements four distinct scenarios—including a business-as-usual baseline and three optimization scenarios—and quantitatively compares their outcomes in terms of agricultural production capacity and ecological land loss. The modeling is spatially explicit at 1 km resolution, includes mapped projections of land use change (Figs. 2–4, S1–S2), and reports quantitative accuracy metrics (Kappa Simulation scores in Table 2). Although the primary objective is balancing cropland protection and ecological conservation, LULC prediction/simulation is central to achieving this goal and constitutes the core methodological contribution. All core inclusion criteria are met, and no exclusion criteria apply.)
